page.layout: One scanned leaf with no body text. Top left: printed library label with the words "...ONALE" and "VITT. EMANUELE" and the numbers 12, 17 A, 30. Centre: printed ownership stamp "Ex Bibliotheca majori Coll. Rom. Societ. Jesu". Lower left: handwritten shelf marks and numbers ("14-8. A.16", "4 8", "d", "22"). Right and lower margins: scanner edge, stains and show-through.
page.notes: No running text, heading or note of the printed book is on this leaf. The printed top-left label (library name and shelf numbers), the ownership stamp "Ex Bibliotheca majori Coll. Rom. Societ. Jesu", the handwritten shelf marks, the stains and the show-through are library furniture and are left out. The stamp reads "Societ. Jesu" with a worn "Societ" and the ink blot partly covers "Coll." and "Rom.".
